panels.description: Average number of live memory objects across all instances of a job.
panels.title: Number of Live Objects

panels.description: The number used bytes at which the runtime plans to perform the next GC, averaged across all instances of a job.
panels.title: Next GC, Bytes
Vary selection decisions
panels.description: Lookup decisions only; admission is shown separately. Internal lease verification reads are excluded.

panels.title: Vary response admission
panels.description: Admission is not successful publication. Legacy no-Vary admissions use reason=legacy.

panels.title: Representation publication
panels.description: Includes paired metadata-only 304/inspection updates as well as new body generations.

panels.title: Unreleased selector leases
panels.description: Counts leases, not distinct selectors; invalidated writers remain counted until cleanup.

panels.title: Logical invalidation outcomes
panels.description: Counts manager barrier calls, including parameter-mapped source barriers; not client PURGE requests.

panels.title: Managed source reuse
panels.description: hit=fresh metadata; revalidate=usable 304; miss=full replacement; failed=source-resolution error.

panels.title: Conversion attempts
panels.description: Actual managed conversion attempts; excludes product hits and startup/CLI contract probes.

panels.title: Successful conversion P95
panels.description: Backend call through output verification/publication. Source acquisition and startup probes are excluded.

panels.title: Queued and active budgets
panels.description: task=whole source/product pipeline; worker=RPC/output budget. Private outputs keep permits until Close.

panels.title: Budget admission rejections
panels.description: Capacity, timeout and cancellation at each budget. Do not treat client cancellation as worker failure.

panels.title: Representation GC decisions
panels.description: Skipped includes reachable, protected and control records. Failed includes scan and deletion errors.

panels.title: Fresh managed-source ratio
panels.description: Fresh source resolutions divided by successful source resolutions; this is not the final product hit ratio.
